falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes above 5,600 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern match is invalidated because the August 2024 low featured a sustained breakdown with no V-recovery above prior resistance; a clean breakout to new highs would prove this is not that structural bottom but rather a shallow dip in an ongoing uptrend

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained VIX compression below 14 would invalidate the bottom pattern because August 2024's bottom formed with VIX remaining elevated (15-20+) for weeks post-low as de-risking continued; rapid vol collapse signals complacency not capitulation

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% and holds there for 2+ days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would falsify the verdict because the August 2024 bottom coincided with yields stabilizing/rising in a growth-scare resolution; a flight-to-quality bid driving yields sharply lower would indicate recession panic rather than soft-landing bottom, breaking the pattern's macro context

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
